analysis:
The PR modifies only docs/architecture/inference.md (no code, no mode changes). The supplied units are BASE text at lines 1611-2365. Changed head ranges are 3, 810-813, 829, 876-895 and 1732-1751. The patch excerpt is truncated, so the 876-895 and 1732-1751 additions were not visible. The 1732-1751 head hunk falls near the base text on the reasoning/tool parser sections (Nemotron stray </think> absorption, ReasoningPromptProbe). Its content is unknown.

The visible hunks are documentation only. They describe GLM5Next video handling: variable-frame-rate tracks are now indexed at i / nominalFrameRate instead of refused with a 400. This is a described behavior change in media decoding (T-050, TB-007 area). The documented bounds remain: the 512 MiB decoded-frame cap, the 28,532 visual-token cap and the 2 FPS sampling. No security control is claimed to be removed. It does widen the accepted media input class. The corresponding source change is not in this batch, so I can't verify that it keeps the decoded-byte and memory-reservation checks for VFR tracks. Treat that as an integration question for any code change.

In the base text I examined, the sections on prefix-cache identity, SSD checkpoints, MiMo media-memory accounting, in-memory video assets (no disk writes, consistent with T-050), and the invariants were not shown to be altered. Nothing in the visible text weakens the T-041 SSD tier controls (30-minute TTL, HMAC lookup tags, salt scoping). I found no evidence of a regression or of a need to update the threat model. The remaining uncertainty is the truncated patch, specifically the added lines at head 876-895 and 1732-1751, which should be checked against the full diff.
